assumption: Observed national GDP per capita is World Bank indicator NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.KD (PPP, constant 2021 international dollars), 2024.
Future growth follows OECD ENV-Growth 2025 GDP|PPP per-capita trajectories from IIASA SSP Basic Drivers release 3.2. Each country and SSP is multiplicatively anchored to the World Bank 2024 value.
The regular-economy 2025 value applies one year of compound growth from the IIASA historical-2020 to projected-2025 interval.

Afghanistan and Palestine use IIASA's separately flagged Turbulent Economy Data and are not robust for country-level analysis. With no historical 2020 value, 2025 is held at the observed 2024 level. Syria and Venezuela are omitted because no World Bank 2024 anchor exists.
National SSP growth factors are applied uniformly to the Kummu et al. 2024 gridded GDP-per-capita pattern for subnational projections.
